claims.quote: Mbói Tu'ĩ  is also used as a Bogeyman by parents to warn children not to swim in dangerous backwater areas.

claims.statement: It is told that in the forest of Tobatí, near the Cavaju hill, there lived a very large snake with a head like a parrot's.
claims.statement_id: Konon di hutan Tobatí, dekat bukit Cavaju, ada seekor ular berukuran sangat besar berkepala seperti burung beo.
claims.quote: se cuenta que en la selva de Tobatí, cerca del cerro Cavaju, existía una víbora de tamaño muy grande con una cabeza semejante a la del loro.

claims.statement: This monster was said to crawl along the ground and also to be able to fly at low altitude.
claims.statement_id: Dikatakan monster ini merayap di tanah dan juga dapat terbang rendah.
claims.quote: Se decía que este monstruo se arrastraba por la tierra y también podía volar a baja altura.

claims.statement: The fearsome Mbói Tu'ĩ is the second son of Tau and Kerana.
claims.statement_id: Mbói Tu'ĩ yang menakutkan adalah putra kedua Tau dan Kerana.
claims.quote: Es el temible MBÓI TU’Ĩ segundo hijo de TAU y KERANA.

claims.statement: He lived among rocks and crags, but his real domain extended over the great marshes.
claims.statement_id: Ia hidup di antara batu dan tebing, tetapi wilayah sesungguhnya meliputi rawa-rawa besar.
claims.quote: Vivía entre rocas y peñascos, pero su real dominio se extendía por los grandes esteros.

claims.statement: Despite his fearsome presence, scholars affirm that Mbói Tu'ĩ is protector of aquatic animals, dew, humidity and flowers.
claims.statement_id: Meskipun tampak menakutkan, para peneliti menyatakan Mbói Tu'ĩ adalah pelindung hewan air, embun, kelembapan, dan bunga.
claims.quote: No obstante su temible presencia, los estudiosos afirman que MBÓI TU’Ĩ es protector de los animales acuáticos, del rocío, de la humedad y de las flores.

claims.statement: This colossal snake-parrot fed only on fruit and dew.
claims.statement_id: Ular-beo raksasa ini hanya makan buah dan embun.
claims.quote: Esta colosal víbora-loro se alimentaba solamente de fruta y del rocío.

claims.statement: In the folklore of Ohio, Michigan and Connecticut, melon heads are large-headed humanoids who sometimes emerge from hiding to attack people.
claims.statement_id: Dalam cerita rakyat Ohio, Michigan, dan Connecticut, melon heads adalah makhluk mirip manusia berkepala sangat besar yang sesekali keluar dari persembunyian untuk menyerang orang.
claims.quote: In the American folklore of Ohio, Michigan and Connecticut, melon heads are beings generally described as large-headed humanoids with bulbous large craniums who occasionally emerge from hiding places to attack people.

claims.statement: Different versions give them different origins.
claims.statement_id: Versi-versi legenda memberi asal-usul yang berbeda bagi mereka.
claims.quote: Different variations of the legend attribute different origins to the entities.

claims.statement: One story says they were originally children with hydrocephalus who lived at the Junction Insane Asylum near Felt Mansion.
claims.statement_id: Menurut satu cerita, mereka semula anak-anak penderita hidrosefalus yang tinggal di Junction Insane Asylum dekat Felt Mansion.
claims.quote: According to one story, they were originally children with hydrocephalus who lived at the Junction Insane Asylum near Felt Mansion.

claims.statement: The Allegan County Historical Society says the asylum never existed.
claims.statement_id: Allegan County Historical Society menyatakan rumah sakit jiwa itu tidak pernah ada.
claims.quote: The Allegan County Historical Society asserts that the asylum never existed

claims.statement: The melon heads of Michigan are said to reside around Felt Mansion, though they have also reportedly been seen in southern forested areas of Ottawa County.
claims.statement_id: Melon heads di Michigan konon tinggal di sekitar Felt Mansion, meski juga dilaporkan terlihat di kawasan hutan di selatan Ottawa County.
claims.quote: The melon heads of Michigan are said to reside around Felt Mansion, although they have also been reportedly seen in southern forested areas of Ottawa County.

claims.statement: Some versions say the children once lived in the mansion itself but later retreated to a system of caverns (or caves in a nearby hill left over from an abandoned zoo).
claims.statement_id: Sebagian versi legenda menyebut anak-anak itu dulu tinggal di rumah besar itu tetapi kemudian mundur ke sistem gua (atau gua di bukit terdekat peninggalan kebun binatang yang ditinggalkan).
claims.quote: Some versions of the legend say that the children once lived in the mansion itself but later retreated to a system of caverns (or caves in a nearby hill left over from an abandoned zoo).

claims.statement: Laketown Township Manager Al Meshkin told the Holland Sentinel he heard the tales as a teenager and that his friends called the beings "wobbleheads".
claims.statement_id: Al Meshkin, manajer Laketown Township, mengatakan kepada Holland Sentinel bahwa ia mendengar kisah itu saat remaja dan teman-temannya menyebut makhluk itu "wobbleheads".
claims.quote: Laketown Township Manager Al Meshkin told the Holland Sentinel that he had heard the tales as a teenager, noting that his friends referred to the beings as "wobbleheads".

claims.statement: According to local lore in Ohio, the melon heads were originally orphans under the watch of a mysterious figure known as Dr. Crow (sometimes spelled Crowe, Krohe or Kroh, or called Dr. Melonhead).
claims.statement_id: Menurut cerita setempat di Ohio, melon heads semula yatim piatu yang diasuh sosok misterius bernama Dr. Crow (kadang ditulis Crowe, Krohe, atau Kroh, atau disebut Dr. Melonhead).
claims.quote: The melon head stories of Ohio are primarily associated with the Cleveland suburb of Kirtland in Lake County. According to local lore, the melon heads were originally orphans under the watch of a mysterious figure known as Dr. Crow (sometimes spelled Crowe, Krohe or Kroh or known as Dr. Melonhead).

claims.statement: The legend continues that the children eventually killed Crow, burned the orphanage, and retreated to the surrounding forests, supposedly feeding on babies.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kelanjutan legenda, anak-anak itu akhirnya membunuh Crow, membakar panti asuhan, lalu mundur ke hutan sekitar dan konon memangsa bayi.
claims.quote: Eventually, the legend continues, the children killed Crow, burned the orphanage, and retreated to the surrounding forests and supposedly feed on babies.

claims.statement: Legend holds that the melon heads may be sighted along Wisner Road in Kirtland and adjacent Chardon Township in Geauga County.
claims.statement_id: Menurut legenda, melon heads dapat terlihat di sepanjang Wisner Road di Kirtland dan Chardon Township di Geauga County.
claims.quote: Legend holds that the melon heads may be sighted along Wisner Road in Kirtland and adjacent Chardon Township in Geauga County.

claims.statement: According to the second Connecticut variation, the melon heads are descendants of a Colonial-era family from Shelton-Trumbull banished after accusations of witchcraft, causing them to retreat to the woods.
claims.statement_id: Menurut varian kedua di Connecticut, melon heads adalah keturunan keluarga era kolonial dari Shelton-Trumbull yang diasingkan setelah dituduh melakukan sihir sehingga mundur ke hutan.
claims.quote: There are several primary Connecticut variations. ... According to the second variation, the melon heads are descendants of a Colonial-era family from Shelton-Trumbull who were banished after accusations of witchcraft were made against them causing them to retreat to the woods.

claims.statement: Melon Heads allegedly prey upon humans who wander into their territory.
claims.statement_id: Melon heads konon memangsa manusia yang tersesat ke wilayah mereka.
claims.quote: Melon Heads allegedly prey upon humans who wander into their territory.

claims.statement: None of the towns that have a melon head legend have roads designated as Dracula Drive.
claims.statement_id: Tidak satu pun kota yang memiliki legenda melon head punya jalan resmi bernama Dracula Drive.
claims.quote: None of the towns that have a melon head legend have roads designated as Dracula Drive.

claims.statement: The proximity of several criminal and psychiatric institutions to rural areas of the county may have contributed elements to the Melon Heads legend.
claims.statement_id: Kedekatan beberapa lembaga pemasyarakatan dan psikiatri dengan daerah pedesaan mungkin menyumbang unsur pada legenda Melon Heads.
claims.quote: The proximity of several criminal and psychiatric institutions as well as their juxtaposition to rural areas of the county may have contributed elements to the legend of the Melon Heads.

claims.statement: The legend even became the subject of a 2011 film titled The Melonheads, based around the West Michigan legend.
claims.statement_id: Legenda itu bahkan menjadi subjek film tahun 2011 berjudul The Melonheads yang berlatar legenda Michigan Barat.
claims.quote: even becoming the subject of a 2011 film simply titled The Melonheads, which is based around the West Michigan legend.

claims.statement: The movie Legend of the Melonheads, released in 2010, is based on the Ohio legend and various other legends in the Kirtland area.
claims.statement_id: Film Legend of the Melonheads, dirilis 2010, berdasar legenda Ohio dan berbagai legenda lain di daerah Kirtland.
claims.quote: A movie, Legend of the Melonheads, released in 2010, is based on the Ohio legend and various other legends in the Kirtland area.

claims.statement: Skeptoid describes the melon head urban legend as children with great balloon-like heads who chase people through forests at night and appear by the roadside to frighten motorists.
claims.statement_id: Skeptoid menggambarkan legenda urban melon heads sebagai anak-anak berkepala besar seperti balon yang mengejar orang di hutan pada malam hari dan muncul di pinggir jalan untuk menakuti pengendara.
claims.quote: children with great big balloon-like heads, chasing people through the forests at night, appearing by the side of the road to frighten motorists, and striking fear into the hearts of those unlucky enough to encounter them.

claims.statement: According to Skeptoid, there are no photographs or videos of the melon heads and no empirical evidence of any kind to examine.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Skeptoid, tidak ada foto atau video melon heads dan tidak ada bukti empiris apa pun untuk diperiksa.
claims.quote: There are no photographs or videos of the melon heads, and no empirical evidence of any kind for us to examine

claims.statement: According to Skeptoid, the standard explanation in most melon head stories, found in several US states, is that the melon heads are children with hydrocephalus.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Skeptoid, penjelasan standar untuk kebanyakan kisah melon heads, yang tersebar di beberapa negara bagian AS, adalah bahwa mereka anak-anak penderita hidrosefalus.
claims.quote: The standard explanation given for most melon head stories — as these legends are found in several US states — is that the melon heads are children with hydrocephalus.

claims.statement: According to Skeptoid, there never was a hospital or asylum anywhere in the vicinity, and such facilities were not in the habit of turning patients loose in the wild.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Skeptoid, tidak pernah ada rumah sakit atau asilum di sekitar tempat itu, dan fasilitas semacam itu tidak biasa melepas pasiennya ke alam liar.
claims.quote: There never was a hospital or asylum anywhere in the vicinity, and even if there had been, such facilities were not in the habit of turning their patients loose to fend for themselves in the wild.

claims.statement: In one variation, a POW camp for German soldiers called Camp Allegan existed there during World War II; the Americans did medical experiments on the prisoners, causing huge swollen heads.
claims.statement_id: Dalam salah satu varian, pada Perang Dunia II ada kamp tawanan perang tentara Jerman bernama Camp Allegan; orang Amerika melakukan eksperimen medis pada para tahanan hingga kepala mereka membengkak besar.
claims.quote: One interesting variation relies on the fact that during World War II, there was a POW camp for German soldiers located there, called Camp Allegan. In this version, the Americans did medical experiments on the German prisoners, causing huge swollen heads.

claims.statement: In the Connecticut story, the melon heads are the result of inbreeding and live in seclusion in the woods on the edge of society.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kisah Connecticut, melon heads adalah akibat perkawinan sedarah dan hidup terpencil di hutan di tepi masyarakat.
claims.quote: Connecticut has a very different version of the melon heads. In that story, the melon heads are the result of inbreeding, and they live in the woods in seclusion on the edge of society.

claims.statement: According to Skeptoid, the basic plot of the Kirtland, Ohio story is that around 1900 a Dr. Crow and his wife, who may have lived on Wisner Road, cared for a number of children with hydrocephalus at home.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Skeptoid, alur dasar kisah Kirtland, Ohio adalah bahwa sekitar tahun 1900 Dr. Crow dan istrinya, yang mungkin tinggal di Wisner Road, merawat sejumlah anak penderita hidrosefalus di rumah mereka.
claims.quote: But the most famous and complete melon head story comes from Kirtland, Ohio. ... the basic plot is that around the year 1900 a Dr. Crow and his wife, who may have lived on Wisner Road, cared for a number of children with hydrocephalus at their home.

claims.statement: In the story the children thought the doctor had killed his wife, rose up and murdered him, set the house on fire and escaped into the woods, living off the land ever since and sometimes appearing to frighten humans.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kisah itu, anak-anak mengira sang dokter membunuh istrinya, lalu menyerang dan membunuhnya, membakar rumah, dan kabur ke hutan; sejak itu mereka hidup dari alam dan kadang muncul menakuti manusia.
claims.quote: The children thought the doctor had killed her, so they rose up and attacked and murdered him. They then set the house on fire and escaped into the woods, where ever since they lived off the land, sometimes appearing and frightening humans.

claims.statement: According to Skeptoid, the story is without evidence; many researchers have tried to find records or news articles mentioning such a doctor, using various spellings of Crow.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Skeptoid, kisah itu tanpa bukti; banyak peneliti telah mencari catatan atau artikel berita tentang dokter semacam itu dengan berbagai ejaan Crow.
claims.quote: The story is without any evidence; any number of researchers have tried to track down records or news articles mentioning such a doctor, using various spellings of Crow.

claims.statement: According to Skeptoid, if the children's heads were visibly enlarged they would have been very young, probably under two, and before the 1940s they were unlikely to have survived at all as shunt treatment had not yet been developed.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Skeptoid, jika kepala anak-anak itu tampak membesar, berarti mereka sangat muda, mungkin kurang dari dua tahun, dan sebelum 1940-an mereka hampir tak mungkin bertahan hidup karena perawatan shunt belum dikembangkan.
claims.quote: If the children's heads were visibly enlarged, it would mean they were very young, probably less than two, and prior to the 1940s it was unlikely they would have survived at all, as the shunt treatment had not yet been developed.

claims.statement: The Skeptoid author argues the melon head stories vilify people with physical disfigurements as monsters, whereas younger generations should rather be taught compassion and acceptance of such people.
claims.statement_id: Penulis Skeptoid berpendapat bahwa kisah melon heads memburukkan orang dengan cacat fisik sebagai monster, padahal generasi muda sebaiknya diajari belas kasih dan penerimaan terhadap mereka.
claims.quote: In previous eras, more people accepted the stigmatization of people with physical disfigurements; today, I would hope, most of us would rather teach our younger generation to have compassion and acceptance for such people, rather than to vilify them as monsters for our late night fiction.

claims.statement: The Piuchén is a vampiric creature of Mapuche and Chilote mythology known across much of Chile.
claims.statement_id: Piuchén adalah makhluk pengisap darah dari mitologi Mapuche dan Chilote yang dikenal di sebagian besar Chile.
claims.quote: is a vampiric creature from the Mapuche mythology and Chilote mythology known in much of  Chile.

claims.statement: It often appears as a flying snake or a bat-winged lizard whose whistles or hisses stun or kill prey.
claims.statement_id: Pengisap darah ini sering berwujud ular terbang atau kadal besar bersayap kelelawar yang siulan atau desisnya melumpuhkan atau membunuh mangsa.
claims.quote: This blood-sucker often assumes the guise of a flying snake, or a large lizard with bat wings, that emits strange whistling sounds or hisses that stun or kill its enemy or prey.

claims.statement: The lore may come from encounters with the common vampire bat.
claims.statement_id: Cerita ini mungkin berasal dari pertemuan dengan kelelawar vampir.
claims.quote: The lore may have derived from encounters with the common vampire bat.

claims.statement: The Piuchén is also written Peuchén, Pihuchén, Piwuchén, or Piguchen (Piguchén).
claims.statement_id: Piuchén juga ditulis Peuchén, Pihuchén, Piwuchén, atau Piguchen (Piguchén).
claims.quote: The Piuchén (Peuchén, Pihuchén, Piwuchén) or Piguchen (Piguchén)

claims.statement: The name Piuchén derives from Mapuche Piwichen for "mythic bird, bat" or "flying serpent"; the word may break down into piwn "to dry" + ché "people".
claims.statement_id: Nama Piuchén berasal dari kata Mapuche Piwichen untuk "burung mitos, kelelawar" atau "ular terbang"; kata itu mungkin terurai menjadi piwn "mengeringkan" + ché "orang".
claims.quote: The name Piuchén (Piuchénes) derives from Mapuche Piwichen (also styled piwicheñ, pihuicheñ) for "mythic bird, bat" or "flying serpent". The piwichen may further break down into piwn 'to dry' + ché 'people'.

claims.statement: It is also described as an avian-piscine-human composite, or a shapeshifter taking on the form of animals.
claims.statement_id: Ia juga digambarkan sebagai makhluk campuran burung, ikan, dan manusia, atau pengubah wujud yang mengambil bentuk hewan.
claims.quote: It is also described as an avian-piscine-human composite, or a shapeshifter taking on the form of animals.

claims.statement: It flies off at night, sucking the blood of animals and humans asleep in the forest; it prefers the season when the roble tree sprouts and is considered a forest spirit.
claims.statement_id: Ia terbang pada malam hari dan mengisap darah hewan dan manusia yang tertidur di hutan; ia menyukai musim ketika pohon roble bertunas dan dianggap roh hutan.
claims.quote: It flies off at night, sucking the blood of animals and humans asleep in the forest. It prefers the season when the roble tree sprouts, and is considered a forest spirit.

claims.statement: In various local versions it may be a serpent with feathered wings (as told in Vichuquén), or a large lizard with bat wings.
claims.statement_id: Dalam berbagai versi lokal, ia dapat berupa ular bersayap berbulu (seperti diceritakan di Vichuquén) atau kadal besar bersayap kelelawar.
claims.quote: In various versions with local variations, it may be a serpent with feathered wings (as told in Vichuquén), or alternatively a large lizard with bat wings.

claims.statement: According to lore near Santiago, the Pihuchén is a black winged snake about 0.5 metres long with a bristly body, whose victims were cattle.
claims.statement_id: Menurut cerita di sekitar Santiago, Pihuchén adalah ular hitam bersayap sepanjang sekitar 0,5 meter dengan tubuh berbulu kaku, yang memangsa ternak.
claims.quote: The Pihuchén is a black winged snake about 0.5 metres (1.6 ft) in length, with a bristly body, according to the lore in the vicinity of Santiago, whose cattle fell victim.

claims.statement: The informant stated the bristles were deadly poison on contact with skin, making live capture impossible, hence eradication by fire without handling the beast.
claims.statement_id: Narasumber menyatakan bulu kakunya mematikan bila menyentuh kulit sehingga menangkapnya hidup-hidup mustahil, maka makhluk itu dibasmi dengan api tanpa disentuh.
claims.quote: The informant stated the bristles were deadly poison upon contact with skin, making (live) capture an impossible task, hence the eradication by fire without handling the beast.

claims.statement: The creature enjoys incredible longevity, and in old age the winged serpent may transform into a rooster-sized or young-turkey-sized bird.
claims.statement_id: Makhluk ini berumur sangat panjang, dan di usia tua ular bersayap itu dapat berubah menjadi burung sebesar ayam jantan atau kalkun muda.
claims.quote: The creature enjoys incredible longevity, and in old age, the winged serpent may transform into a rooster-sized bird, or a young turkey sized bird.

claims.statement: In another telling from Ovalle in the Coquimbo Region, the Piuchén "has a parrot's beak and wings, a toad-like body and a snake-like tail".
claims.statement_id: Dalam versi lain dari Ovalle di Wilayah Coquimbo, Piuchén "berparuh dan bersayap beo, bertubuh seperti kodok, dan berekor seperti ular".
claims.quote: In another telling from Ovalle in the Coquimbo Region, the Piuchén "has a parrot's beak and wings, a toad-like body and a snake-like tail".

claims.statement: Others considered its hiss and gaze capable of killing prey, or the gaze may paralyze the victim so the creature leisurely feeds on its blood.
claims.statement_id: Sebagian menganggap desis dan tatapannya dapat membunuh mangsa, atau tatapannya melumpuhkan korban sehingga makhluk itu santai mengisap darahnya.
claims.quote: Others considered its hiss and gaze capable of killing prey, or the gaze may paralyze the victim and the creature then leisurely feeds on the blood of the stupefied victim.

claims.statement: In Chilote folklore the creature is described as a protean composite, part human, snake, bird and fish, covered with grass, bushes and twisted horn-like protrusions.
claims.statement_id: Dalam cerita rakyat Chilote, makhluk ini digambarkan sebagai makhluk campuran yang berubah-ubah, sebagian manusia, ular, burung, dan ikan, tertutup rumput, semak, dan tonjolan seperti tanduk yang berpilin.
claims.quote: In Chilote folklore, the creature is described as a protean composite creature, part human, snake, bird, and fish, and covered with all sorts of things such as grass, bushes, and twisted horn-like protrusions

claims.statement: It prefers to dwell in lakes and rivers, haunting the local Lake Huillinco, and can allegedly raise gigantic waves that sink nearby boats.
claims.statement_id: Ia lebih suka tinggal di danau dan sungai serta menghantui Danau Huillinco setempat; konon ia dapat membangkitkan gelombang raksasa yang menenggelamkan perahu di dekatnya.
claims.quote: preferring to dwell in lakes and rivers, haunting the local Lake Huillinco. It allegedly can raise gigantic waves that cause nearby boats to sink.

claims.statement: According to Chilote lore the piuchén is so powerful it effortlessly knocks down the Chilean larch (alerces), the tique or other huge trees.
claims.statement_id: Menurut cerita Chilote, piuchén begitu kuat sehingga tanpa kesulitan merobohkan alerce (cemara Chile), tique, atau pohon raksasa lain.
claims.quote: The piuchén is so powerful it effortlessly knocks down this Chilean larch (alerces), the tique ... or other huge trees, according to Chilote lore

claims.statement: It is also claimed that only the machi can defeat the creature, as he or she can counteract the hypnosis with herbal cures.
claims.statement_id: Juga diklaim bahwa hanya machi yang dapat mengalahkan makhluk itu karena ia dapat menangkal hipnosis dengan ramuan herbal.
claims.quote: it is also claimed that only the machi alone can defeat the creature, as he or she can counteract the hypnosis with herbal cures.

claims.statement: According to Mapuche belief the Pihuichéñ coordinated its attacks with the machi (herbal healer), and they were in alliance.
claims.statement_id: Menurut kepercayaan Mapuche, Pihuichéñ mengoordinasikan serangannya dengan machi (tabib herbal) dan keduanya bersekutu.
claims.quote: Mapuche belief was that the Pihuichéñ coordinated its attacks with the machi (herbal healer), and they were in alliance

claims.statement: To kill a Pihuchén living in a tree hollow, it is suggested to plug the hole with heavy cloth and then set the tree on fire.
claims.statement_id: Untuk membunuh Pihuchén yang tinggal di lubang pohon, disarankan menyumbat lubang dengan kain tebal lalu membakar pohonnya.
claims.quote: to kill a Pihuchén living in a Tree hollow (hueco), it is suggested the hole be plugged with hefty cloth then to set the tree on fire.

claims.statement: Superstition in Ovalle recommends waving a white flag or whistling in a bottle to ward the creature off, and adding a white goat to one's flock lessens the chance of attack.
claims.statement_id: Takhayul di Ovalle menganjurkan mengibarkan bendera putih atau bersiul ke dalam botol untuk menangkal makhluk itu, dan menambah kambing putih ke kawanan mengurangi peluang diserang.
claims.quote: Superstition in Ovalle recommends waving a white flag or whistling in a bottle to ward the creature off, and adds that adding white goat to one's flock diminishes the chance of being attacked.

claims.statement: According to modern zoologists this species name is a disused synonym of Desmodus rotundus, the common vampire bat, also known by the Spanish vernacular "Piuchén".
claims.statement_id: Menurut zoolog modern, nama spesies itu sinonim lama dari Desmodus rotundus, kelelawar vampir biasa, yang dalam bahasa Spanyol sehari-hari juga disebut "Piuchén".
claims.quote: According to modern zoologists, this species name is a disused synonym of Desmodus rotundus, the common vampire bat, also known by the Spanish vernacular "Piuchén".

claims.statement: The abbot Juan Ignacio Molina also wrote a paragraph on the "winged quadruped, or a kind of large bat"; a later lexicographer remarked that Molina had been deceived by a gift of a dead rare animal claimed to be a piuchén and only described that cadaver.
claims.statement_id: Abbé Juan Ignacio Molina juga menulis satu paragraf tentang "kuadruped bersayap, atau sejenis kelelawar besar"; seorang leksikograf kemudian menyatakan Molina tertipu oleh hadiah bangkai hewan langka yang diklaim sebagai piuchén sehingga ia hanya menggambarkan bangkai itu.
claims.quote: The abbot Juan Ignacio Molina also wrote a paragraph on the "winged quadruped, or a kind of large bat". A later lexicographer remarked that Molina had been deceived by a gift of some dead rare animal claimed to be a piuchén, and the abbot only described such cadaver in detail.

claims.statement: The author wonders whether the Piguchén might have been the precursor of the Chupacabra.
claims.statement_id: Penulis bertanya-tanya apakah Piguchén mungkin pendahulu Chupacabra.
claims.quote: He wonders if the Piguchén might have been the precursor of the Chupacabra.

claims.statement: A digitized natural history calls the Piguchén a winged quadruped or kind of large bat which, if it really existed, would be one of the links joining birds to quadrupeds.
claims.statement_id: Sebuah teks sejarah alam yang didigitalkan menyebut Piguchén sebagai kuadruped bersayap atau sejenis kelelawar besar yang, andai nyata, akan menjadi salah satu mata rantai penghubung burung dan kuadruped.
claims.quote: Tal es por exemplo el Piguchén, quadrúpedo alado, ó especie de gran murciegalo, que á exîstir en la realidad, formaria uno de los eslabones ú anillos que unen los páxaros á los quadrúpedos.

claims.statement: According to the text, this animal is said to be the size and shape of the domestic rabbit, covered with fine cinnamon-colored hair, with a pointed muzzle, large round shining eyes, almost invisible ears, membranous wings and short legs like a lizard's.
claims.statement_id: Menurut teks itu, hewan ini konon sebesar dan berbentuk seperti kelinci rumahan, berbulu halus berwarna kayu manis, berhidung runcing, bermata besar bulat dan berkilau, bertelinga nyaris tak tampak, bersayap selaput, dan berkaki pendek seperti kadal.
claims.quote: Este animal, que segun dicen, es de la magnitud y figura del conejo casero, está cubierto de un pelo fino de color de canela: tiene el hocico aguzado: los ojos grandes, redondos y resplandecientes: las orejas casi invisibles: las alas membranosas: las patas cortas, y semejantes á las del lagarto

claims.statement: According to the text, the animal hisses like snakes, flies like partridges (perdiz), lives in tree hollows from which it comes out only at night, and harms no one except the insects that serve as its food.
claims.statement_id: Menurut teks itu, hewan ini bersiul seperti ular, terbang seperti burung perdiz (partridge), tinggal di lubang pohon dan keluar hanya pada malam hari, dan tidak mencelakai siapa pun kecuali serangga yang menjadi makanannya.
claims.quote: silva como las culebras, y vuela como las perdices: habita en los huecos de los árboles, de donde sale unicamente durante la noche, y no hace mal á nadie sino es á los insectos, que le sirven de pasto.

claims.statement: Teju Jagua is the first son of Tau and Kerana, one of the seven legendary monsters of Guaraní mythology.
claims.statement_id: Teju Jagua adalah putra pertama Tau dan Kerana, salah satu dari tujuh monster legendaris mitologi Guaraní.
claims.quote: is the first son of Tau and Kerana and one of the seven legendary monsters of Guaraní mythology.

claims.statement: Their first son was a huge lizard with seven dog heads and fire-shooting eyes.
claims.statement_id: Putra pertama itu berupa kadal raksasa berkepala tujuh anjing dengan mata yang memancarkan api.
claims.quote: Thus, the pair's first son was a huge lizard with seven dog-heads and eyes that shoot out fire.

claims.statement: He is considered lord of the caves and protector of fruit.
claims.statement_id: Ia dianggap penguasa gua dan pelindung buah-buahan.
claims.quote: He is considered the lord of the caves and protector of fruit.

claims.statement: Because of the curse Arasy placed on Tau for raping Kerana, Tau's descendants were cursed forever with a deformed and monstrous appearance.
claims.statement_id: Karena kutukan Arasy atas Tau karena memerkosa Kerana, keturunan Tau dikutuk selamanya berwujud cacat dan mengerikan.
claims.quote: Because of the curse placed upon Tau by Arasy for raping Kerana, Tau's descendants were forever cursed to a deformed and monstrous appearance.

claims.statement: His seven dog heads make any movement difficult. Some versions say Teju Jagua has only one giant dog head, but all versions agree he has a limited ability to move around.
claims.statement_id: Tujuh kepala anjingnya membuat setiap gerakan sulit. Sebagian versi menyebut Teju Jagua hanya berkepala satu anjing raksasa, tetapi semua versi sepakat bahwa kemampuannya bergerak terbatas.
claims.quote: His seven dog-heads make any movement difficult. Some versions of the story say Teju Jagua has only one giant dog-head. But all versions agree that he has a limited ability to move around.

claims.statement: However, his ferocity was tempered by Tupã's choice; he was left calm and harmless. Still he was feared for his fiery gaze.
claims.statement_id: Namun keganasannya diredam oleh pilihan Tupã; ia dibiarkan tenang dan tidak berbahaya. Meski begitu ia ditakuti karena tatapan apinya.
claims.quote: However, his ferocity was tempered by choice of Tupã. He was left calm and harmless. Still he was feared for his fiery gaze.

claims.statement: He feeds on fruit, and his brother Yasy Yateré gave him honey, his favorite food.
claims.statement_id: Ia makan buah, dan saudaranya Yasy Yateré memberinya madu, makanan kesukaannya.
claims.quote: He feeds on fruit and his brother Yasy Yateré gave him honey, his favorite food.

claims.statement: He is also mentioned as a brilliant protector of buried treasure.
claims.statement_id: Ia juga disebut sebagai pelindung gemilang harta terpendam.
claims.quote: He is also mentioned as a brilliant protector of buried treasure.

claims.statement: Its skin became shiny after rolling around in the gold and precious stones of Itapé.
claims.statement_id: Kulitnya menjadi berkilau setelah berguling-guling di antara emas dan batu mulia di Itapé.
claims.quote: Its skin became shiny after rolling around in the gold and precious stones of Itapé.

claims.statement: Teju Jagua was the first son of Tau and Kerana, shaped like an enormous lizard with a dog's head, and was considered the master of the caverns.
claims.statement_id: Teju Jagua adalah putra pertama Tau dan Kerana, berbentuk kadal raksasa berkepala anjing, dan dianggap penguasa gua-gua.
claims.quote: TEJU JAGUA fue el primer hijo de TAU y KERANA; tenía la forma de un enorme lagarto con cabeza de perro. Se le consideraba el dominador de las cavernas.

claims.statement: His lair was in one of the abysses of the legendary Yaguarón hill.
claims.statement_id: Sarangnya berada di salah satu jurang di bukit legendaris Yaguarón.
claims.quote: Su guarida la tenía en uno de los abismos del legendario cerro de Yaguarón.

claims.statement: Many believe he carried his victim to the cavern to devour it.
claims.statement_id: Banyak orang percaya ia membawa korbannya ke gua untuk melahapnya.
claims.quote: Muchos creen que llevaba a su víctima hasta la caverna para devorarla.

claims.statement: Among the inhabitants of the Yaguarón hill it was also believed that Teju Jagua fed only on fruit and wild honey.
claims.statement_id: Di antara penduduk bukit Yaguarón juga dipercaya bahwa Teju Jagua hanya makan buah dan madu liar.
claims.quote: También se creía entre los moradores del cerro Yaguarón, que TEJU JAGUA sólo se alimentaba de frutas y miel silvestre.

claims.statement: The local natives regarded him as the master of the grottoes, whose mission was to look after and protect trees and fruit.
claims.statement_id: Penduduk asli setempat menganggapnya penguasa gua yang bertugas menjaga dan melindungi pohon serta buah.
claims.quote: Los nativos lugareños lo consideraban como el que dominaba las grutas y el que tenía por misión cuidar y proteger árboles y frutas.

claims.statement: He was also considered the monster who protected the hidden treasures of the Guaraní people; having rolled on gold dust (Itaju), his skin shone like gold and precious stones.
claims.statement_id: Ia juga dianggap monster yang melindungi harta tersembunyi bangsa Guaraní; karena berguling di atas debu emas (Itaju), kulitnya berkilau seperti emas dan batu mulia.
claims.quote: También se le consideraba el monstruo que protegía los tesoros ocultos de la raza guaraní. Por haberse revolcado sobre polvo aurífero (Itaju), su piel brillaba como oro y piedras preciosas.

claims.statement: From time to time in summer, his little brother Jasy Jatere took him along.
claims.statement_id: Dari waktu ke waktu pada musim panas, adik kecilnya Jasy Jatere membawanya.
claims.quote: de tarde en tarde, en época de verano, su hermanito JASY JATERE le llevaba

claims.statement: According to the writer and scholar Paulo Carvalho Neto in his book Folklore del Paraguay, in 1933 Ramón I. Cardozo collected in Villa Rica a tale about Teju Jagua.
claims.statement_id: Menurut penulis dan peneliti Paulo Carvalho Neto dalam bukunya Folklore del Paraguay, pada 1933 Ramón I. Cardozo mencatat di Villa Rica sebuah kisah tentang Teju Jagua.
claims.quote: El escritor y estudioso Paulo Carvalho Neto nos dice en su libro Folklore del Paraguay que en 1933 Ramón I. Cardozo recogió en Villa Rica un relato de TEJU JAGUA

claims.statement: In the tale, the Portuguese don Luis Home arrived in Paraguay and settled in Villa Rica del Espíritu Santo.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kisah itu, orang Portugis bernama don Luis Home tiba di Paraguay dan menetap di Villa Rica del Espíritu Santo.
claims.quote: llegó al Paraguay el portugués don Luis Home y se estableció en Villa Rica del Espíritu Santo

claims.statement: Some said that D. Luis kept Teju Jagua, a man-devouring monster of invincible destructive power, hidden in the labyrinth of his castle, fattening him on human flesh to use him one day for some unknown plan.
claims.statement_id: Muncul orang yang mengatakan bahwa D. Luis menyembunyikan Teju Jagua, monster pelahap manusia berkekuatan perusak tak terkalahkan, di labirin istananya dan memberinya makan daging manusia untuk dipakai suatu hari.
claims.quote: Ya no faltó quien dijera que el purutue D. Luis tenía oculto en el laberinto de su castillo a TEJU JAGUA, monstruo devorador de hombres e invencible poder destructivo. Lo tenía cebándolo con carne humana para utilizarlo, algún día, en la consecución de quién sabe qué plan.

claims.statement: The legend soon took shape and life; everyone believed it to the point that nobody dared pass near D. Luis's house at night.
claims.statement_id: Legenda itu segera hidup; semua orang memercayainya sampai tak seorang pun berani lewat malam hari di dekat rumah D. Luis.
claims.quote: Pronto esta leyenda tomó cuerpo y vida. Todo el mundo la creyó a pie juntillas, hasta el extremo de que nadie osaba pasar de noche por las proximidades de la casa de D. Luis

claims.statement: In Innu mythology, Wentshukumishiteu is a water spirit who fiercely protects the young of several animals from human hunters.
claims.statement_id: Dalam mitologi Innu, Wentshukumishiteu adalah roh air yang dengan garang melindungi anak-anak berbagai hewan dari pemburu manusia.
claims.quote: In der Mythologie der Innu ist Wentshukumishiteu (oder Uentshukumishiteu) ein Wassergeist, der grimmig den Nachwuchs mehrerer Tierarten vor menschlichen Jägern beschützt.

claims.statement: He is said to be especially fond of otters.
claims.statement_id: Ia konon terutama menyukai berang-berang.
claims.quote: Otter soll er hierbei besonders mögen.

claims.statement: One of his homes is said to lie beneath Manitutshu, the spirit mountain, near Muskrat Falls on the Churchill River in Labrador.
claims.statement_id: Salah satu kediamannya konon berada di bawah Manitutshu, "gunung roh", dekat Muskrat Falls di Churchill River, Labrador.
claims.quote: Eine seiner Heimstätten liegt angeblich unter Manitutshu, dem Geisterberg, einem Hügel bei den Muskrat Falls am Churchill River in Labrador, Kanada.

claims.statement: The article states that "the Inuit" say Wentshukumishiteu can move anywhere on the water and break through even the thickest ice.
claims.statement_id: Artikel itu menyatakan bahwa "orang Inuit" mengatakan Wentshukumishiteu dapat bergerak di mana saja di atas air dan menembus es setebal apa pun.
claims.quote: Die Inuit sagen, dass Wentshukumishiteu in der Lage sei, sich überall auf dem Wasser zu bewegen und auch das dickste Eis durchbrechen kann.

claims.statement: He is likewise said to be able to travel under the ground and through rock.
claims.statement_id: Ia juga konon dapat berjalan di bawah tanah dan menembus batu.
claims.quote: Ebenso soll er unter dem Erdboden und durch Gestein wandern können.

claims.statement: Spirit Mountain is a sacred Innu site where tens of thousands of Innu artifacts were discovered during the early stages of a project's construction.
claims.statement_id: Spirit Mountain adalah situs suci Innu tempat puluhan ribu artefak Innu ditemukan pada tahap awal pembangunan sebuah proyek.
claims.quote: Spirit Mountain, a sacred Innu site where tens of thousands of Innu artifacts were discovered during the early stages of the project’s construction

claims.statement: The North Spur is a natural hill 1,000 metres long connecting Spirit Mountain, a significant spiritual site for the Innu, to the north shore at Muskrat Falls.
claims.statement_id: North Spur adalah bukit alami sepanjang 1.000 meter yang menghubungkan Spirit Mountain, situs spiritual penting bagi Innu, dengan tepi utara Muskrat Falls.
claims.quote: The North Spur is a natural hill 1,000 metres long connecting Spirit Mountain [a significant spiritual site for the Innu] to the north shore at Muskrat Falls

claims.statement: Amala is a giant who supports the world in Tsimshian, Nass, Skidegate, Kaigani, Massett and Tlingit mythology.
claims.statement_id: Amala adalah raksasa penyangga dunia dalam mitologi Tsimshian, Nass, Skidegate, Kaigani, Massett, dan Tlingit.
claims.quote: Amala is a mythological giant who supports the world in the mythology of the Tsimshian, Nass, Skidegate, Kaigani, Massett, and Tlingit Native Americans.

claims.statement: He balances the Earth on a spinning pole.
claims.statement_id: Ia menyangga Bumi yang diseimbangkannya di atas tiang berputar.
claims.quote: He supports the Earth which he balances on a spinning pole.

claims.statement: When all the ducks are hunted out and no duck-oil remains, Amala dies and the world falls off the pole and ends.
claims.statement_id: Diyakini bahwa ketika semua bebek habis diburu dan minyak bebek tidak ada lagi, Amala mati dan dunia jatuh dari tiangnya lalu berakhir.
claims.quote: The belief is that when all the ducks are hunted out, there will no longer be any duck-oil available in the world. At this point, Amala dies and the world topples off the pole and comes to an end.

claims.statement: The name Amala refers to his being very dirty and literally means "smoke hole".
claims.statement_id: Nama Amala merujuk pada sosoknya yang sangat kotor dan secara harfiah berarti "lubang asap".
claims.quote: The name Amala refers to his being very dirty and literally means “smoke hole.”

claims.statement: Amala is said to be the youngest child in a family, physically weak and lazy, made to sleep in the ashes and mistreated by everybody.
claims.statement_id: Amala dikisahkan sebagai anak bungsu dalam keluarga yang lemah dan malas, disuruh tidur di abu, dan diperlakukan buruk oleh semua orang.
claims.quote: Amala is said to be the youngest child in a family who is physically weak and lazy. He is made to sleep in the ashes and suffers mistreatment from everybody.

claims.statement: Later in life he secretly gains supernatural strength and becomes a handsome, powerful young man who performs many daring feats and becomes savior and protector of his relatives against their enemies.
claims.statement_id: Di kemudian hari ia diam-diam memperoleh kekuatan supernatural, menjadi pemuda tampan dan kuat yang melakukan banyak aksi berani, dan menjadi penyelamat serta pelindung kerabatnya dari musuh.
claims.quote: Late in his life he attains supernatural strength in secret and becomes a handsome, and powerful young man who performs many daring feats and turns savior and protector for his relatives against their enemies.

claims.statement: The concluding feat of his life is to take over from a dying chief on an island in the Southwest sea the task of holding the Earth up.
claims.statement_id: Puncak hidupnya adalah menggantikan seorang kepala suku yang sekarat di sebuah pulau di laut barat daya dalam tugas menyangga Bumi.
claims.quote: The concluding feat of his life is to succeed a dying chief on an island in the Southwest sea in the task of holding the Earth up.

claims.statement: Some versions say the chief places the pole on Amala's chest, while others hold that the pole is held behind Amala's back.
claims.statement_id: Sebagian versi mengisahkan sang kepala suku meletakkan tiang di dada Amala, sedangkan versi lain menyebut tiang itu ditahan di belakang punggung Amala.
claims.quote: Some versions of the myth state that the chief places the pole on Amala's chest, while some versions hold that the pole is held behind Amala's back.

claims.statement: It is possible that the myths about Amala and similar heroes of Native American mythology were influenced by the tales of Cinderella and Atlas.
claims.statement_id: Ada kemungkinan mitos tentang Amala dan pahlawan sejenis dalam mitologi pribumi Amerika dipengaruhi kisah Cinderella dan Atlas.
claims.quote: There is a possibility that the myths about Amala and similar heroes of Native American mythology were influenced by the tales of Cinderella and Atlas

claims.statement: Amala still holds the world on his chest, and when he dies the world will end.
claims.statement_id: Amala masih menyangga dunia di dadanya, dan ketika ia mati dunia akan berakhir.
claims.quote: Amala still holds the world on his chest, but when he dies the world will end.

claims.statement: The old chief, ill and dying, heard of Amala's supernatural strength and sent for him to take over the task.
claims.statement_id: Kepala suku tua yang sakit dan sekarat mendengar tentang kekuatan supernatural Amala dan memanggilnya untuk mengambil alih tugas itu.
claims.quote: The old chief, ill and dying, heard of Amala’s supernatural strength and sent for him to take over the task.

claims.statement: The dictionary calls the figure "Amala or Very Dirty".
claims.statement_id: Kamus ini menyebut tokoh tersebut "Amala atau Very Dirty" (Sangat Kotor).
claims.quote: Amala or Very Dirty was the youngest of a number of

claims.statement: The dictionary says the story partakes of the Cinderella theme in that Amala slept in the ashes.
claims.statement_id: Kamus ini menyebut kisah Amala memuat tema Cinderella karena Amala tidur di abu.
claims.quote: The story partakes of the Cinderella theme in that Amala slept in the ashes

claims.statement: According to the dictionary, the idea of the earth on a pole is limited to the Tsimshians, Tlingits, Skidegates, and Hares.
claims.statement_id: Menurut kamus ini, gagasan bumi di atas tiang hanya terbatas pada bangsa Tsimshian, Tlingit, Skidegate, dan Hare.
claims.quote: The earth on the pole idea is limited to the Tsimshians, Tlingits, Skidegates, and Hares.

claims.statement: J. R. Swanton suspects, but does not assume, white influence in the idea of the earth turning on the pole.
claims.statement_id: J. R. Swanton menduga, tetapi tidak memastikan, adanya pengaruh orang kulit putih pada gagasan bumi yang berputar di atas tiang.
claims.quote: The white man’s influence is suspected, but not assumed, by J. R. Swanton, in the turning of the earth upon the pole idea

claims.statement: Anhangá is a type of spirit in the worldview of several native Brazilian groups and Indianist literature.
claims.statement_id: Anhangá adalah jenis roh dalam pandangan dunia beberapa kelompok pribumi Brasil dan sastra Indianis.
claims.quote: is a type of spirit present in the cosmovision of several native groups from Brazil  and Indianist literature.

claims.statement: The spirit is believed to torment the souls of the dead, manifested as tempestuous noises.
claims.statement_id: Roh ini diyakini menyiksa jiwa orang mati, yang tampak di alam sebagai suara-suara bergemuruh.
claims.quote: The spirit is believed to torment the soul of the dead, manifested in nature as tempestuous noises.

claims.statement: It is a guardian of wild game in the open field.
claims.statement_id: Ia penjaga hewan buruan di padang terbuka.
claims.quote: as it is a guardian of wildlife game in the open field

claims.statement: It usually appears as a white deer with fiery eyes.
claims.statement_id: Ia biasanya menampakkan diri sebagai rusa putih bermata menyala.
claims.quote: usually appears in the guise of white deer with fiery eyes.

claims.statement: The Tupinambá people believed that Anhangá could take many different forms.
claims.statement_id: Suku Tupinambá percaya bahwa Anhangá dapat mengambil banyak wujud berbeda.
claims.quote: The Tupinambá people believed that Anhangá could take many different forms

claims.statement: The Tupinambás were said to fear this malignant spirit more than anything else.
claims.statement_id: Orang Tupinambá konon lebih takut pada roh jahat ini daripada apa pun.
claims.quote: The Tupinambás were said to fear this malignant spirit more than anything else.

claims.statement: To the Mawés, the Anhangá (Sateré-Mawé: ahiãg) is portrayed as a demon, a follower of Yurupari (Jurupari), feared for taking various forms to fool, curse, possess, kidnap, kill and eat people.
claims.statement_id: Bagi suku Mawé, Anhangá (Sateré-Mawé: ahiãg) digambarkan sebagai iblis, pengikut Yurupari (Jurupari), yang ditakuti karena dapat mengambil berbagai wujud untuk menipu, mengutuk, merasuki, menculik, membunuh, dan memakan manusia.
claims.quote: To the Mawés, the Anhangá (Sateré-Mawé: ahiãg) is portrayed as a demon, a follower of Yurupari (Jurupari). These creatures are known and feared for being able to take various forms to fool people, curse, possess, kidnap, kill and eat them.

claims.statement: According to 19th-century writings (by Couto de Magalhães), Anhangá takes the form of a white deer with fiery eyes and protects the animals of the open fields (campo) against abusive hunting.
claims.statement_id: Menurut tulisan abad ke-19 (oleh Couto de Magalhães), Anhangá berwujud rusa putih bermata api dan melindungi hewan di padang terbuka (campo) dari perburuan yang berlebihan.
claims.quote: As attested in 19th century writings (by Couto de Magalhães), Anhangá takes the form of a white deer with fiery eyes and he is the protector of animals of the open fields (campo), guarding animals against abusive hunting practices in such terrain.

claims.statement: According to tradition, Anhangá alters the outcome of a hunt in the field by inflicting "fever and sometimes madness" on a hunter who pursues a nursing animal.
claims.statement_id: Menurut tradisi, Anhangá mengubah hasil perburuan di padang dengan menimpakan "demam dan kadang kegilaan" pada pemburu yang mengejar hewan yang sedang menyusui.
claims.quote: the Anhanga will alter the outcome of a chase in the field, by inflicting "fever and sometimes madness" on a hunter who pursues a nursing animal

claims.statement: One suggested etymology of Anhanga is anho "alone" + anga "ghost, spirit".
claims.statement_id: Salah satu usulan etimologi Anhanga adalah anho "sendiri" + anga "hantu, roh".
claims.quote: A suggested etymology of Anhanga is anho "alone" + anga "ghost, spirit".

claims.statement: The missionary André Thevet, writing in the 16th century, recorded that natives travelling over water believed the noise of tempests came from "the souls of relatives and friends", associated with the agnan.
claims.statement_id: Misionaris André Thevet pada abad ke-16 mencatat bahwa penduduk asli yang bepergian di atas air meyakini bunyi badai berasal dari "jiwa kerabat dan teman" yang dikaitkan dengan agnan.
claims.quote: The missionary André Thevet, writing in the 16th century, records that the natives, while traveling over water, believed that the noise of tempests or hurricanes they heard was caused by "the souls of relatives and friends", associated with the agnan.

claims.statement: Raimundo Morais's dictionary defines Anhanga as an indigenous god who protects birds and quadrupeds from hunters' attacks on the grasslands and savannas.
claims.statement_id: Kamus Raimundo Morais mendefinisikan Anhanga sebagai dewa asli yang melindungi burung dan hewan berkaki empat dari serangan pemburu di padang dan sabana.
claims.quote: Anhanga – Deus autóctone que preserva do ataque dos caçadores, nas campinas e savanas, as aves, os quadrúpedes e os pássaros.

claims.statement: According to Raimundo Morais, Anhanga corresponds to shadow or spirit but embodies itself as a white deer with eyes of fire; whoever hunts an animal with a small young one is haunted by it and driven mad.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Raimundo Morais, Anhanga berarti bayangan atau roh, tetapi menjelma sebagai rusa putih bermata api; siapa pun yang memburu hewan yang punya anak kecil akan dihantui dan dibuat gila olehnya.
claims.quote: Anhanga corresponde a sombra, espírito, mas corporifica-se num veado branco, de olhos de fogo. Quem persegue no mato um bicho com filho pequenino, é assombrado por ele, que desvaira e enlouquece o temerário.

claims.statement: Portal Amazônia says Anhangá represents the god of the underworld or infernal territories, a wandering spirit that can take the form of various animals.
claims.statement_id: Portal Amazônia menyebut Anhangá mewakili dewa dunia bawah atau wilayah neraka, serta roh pengembara yang dapat berwujud berbagai hewan.
claims.quote: Ele representa o deus do submundo ou territórios infernais. É um espírito andarilho que pode tomar forma de vários animais.

claims.statement: Portal Amazônia says Anhangá is also considered an enemy of Tupã (the creator god); although regarded as a protector of animals and hunters, he is associated with evil.
claims.statement_id: Portal Amazônia menyebut Anhangá juga dianggap musuh Tupã (dewa pencipta dunia); meski dianggap pelindung hewan dan pemburu, ia dikaitkan dengan kejahatan.
claims.quote: Também é considerado inimigo de Tupã (o deus criador do mundo). Apesar de ser considerado um protetor dos animais e caçadores, Anhangá é associado ao mal.

claims.statement: Similar guardianship in the bush or forest (mato) is assumed by Cahipora/Cahapora (i.e. Caipora).
claims.statement_id: Penjagaan serupa di semak atau hutan (mato) dipegang oleh Cahipora/Cahapora (yaitu Caipora).
claims.quote: Similar guardianship in the bush or forest (mato) is assumed by Cahipora/Cahapora (i.e. Caipora).

claims.statement: In a legend from Santarém, a Tupinambá hunter chased a doe and her suckling fawn, made the fawn squeal to draw in the mother and shot her, but he had been deceived by Anhangá's illusions and had shot his own mother.
claims.statement_id: Dalam legenda dari Santarém, seorang pemburu Tupinambá mengejar rusa betina dan anaknya yang masih menyusu; ia membuat anak rusa menjerit untuk memancing induknya lalu menembaknya, padahal ia tertipu ilusi Anhangá dan menembak ibunya sendiri.
claims.quote: a legend from Santarém where a Tupinambá hunter pursued a doe and her suckling fawn. He grabbed the fawn, making it squeal to attract the mother and shot her. ... In fact he had been confused by the Anhangá's illusions and had shot his own mother to death.

claims.statement: Anhangá is also known as Kaagere.
claims.statement_id: Anhangá juga dikenal dengan nama Kaagere.
claims.quote: It is also otherwise known as Kaagere.

claims.statement: Câmara Cascudo argued that the Anhanga is a myth of verbal confusion: what made people tremble was the Anga, the wandering soul, the phantom, the spirit of the dead, and the deer myth changed in more modern periods.
claims.statement_id: Câmara Cascudo menilai Anhanga sebagai mitos kebingungan kata: yang menggetarkan orang dahulu adalah Anga, jiwa pengembara, hantu, roh orang mati; mitos rusa menurutnya berubah di masa yang lebih modern.
claims.quote: Câmara Cascudo discussed how the original deer myth as described by Magalhães had transformed in more modern periods ... The Anhanga is a myth of verbal confusion. The Anhanga that made the savage shake in fear was the Anga, the wandering soul, the phantom, the spirit of the dead.

claims.statement: The Highgate Vampire was a 1970s media sensation over reported supernatural activity at Highgate Cemetery in London.
claims.statement_id: Highgate Vampire adalah sensasi media seputar laporan aktivitas gaib di Highgate Cemetery, London, pada tahun 1970-an.
claims.quote: The Highgate Vampire was a media sensation surrounding reports of supposed supernatural activity at Highgate Cemetery in London, England, United Kingdom, in the 1970s.

claims.statement: The fullest account is by folklorist Bill Ellis in the journal Folklore (1993).
claims.statement_id: Kajian paling lengkap tentang kisah ini ditulis folklorist Bill Ellis dalam jurnal Folklore (1993).
claims.quote: The most thorough account of the story is given by folklorist Bill Ellis in the journal Folklore, published in 1993.

claims.statement: According to Wikipedia, the reported ghosts were described as a tall man in a hat, a spectral cyclist, a woman in white, a face glaring through the bars of a gate, a figure wading into a pond, a pale gliding form, bells ringing, and voices calling.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Wikipedia, hantu-hantu yang dilaporkan digambarkan sebagai lelaki tinggi bertopi, pesepeda bayangan, perempuan berbaju putih, wajah yang melotot dari sela jeruji gerbang, sosok yang berjalan masuk ke kolam, wujud pucat yang melayang, lonceng berbunyi, dan suara-suara memanggil.
claims.quote: These ghosts were described as a tall man in a hat, a spectral cyclist, a woman in white, a face glaring through the bars of a gate, a figure wading into a pond, a pale gliding form, bells ringing, and voices calling.

claims.statement: According to Wikipedia, Sean Manchester claimed Farrant's "grey figure" was a vampire and the media quickly latched on.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Wikipedia, Sean Manchester menyatakan "sosok kelabu" yang dilihat Farrant adalah vampir, dan media dengan cepat menyambarnya.
claims.quote: Sean Manchester claimed Farrant's "grey figure" was a vampire and the media quickly latched on

claims.statement: According to Wikipedia, within two hours a mob of "hunters" from all over London and beyond swarmed over gates and walls into the locked cemetery despite police efforts to control them.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Wikipedia, dalam dua jam segerombolan "pemburu" dari seluruh London dan sekitarnya memanjat gerbang dan tembok memasuki pemakaman yang terkunci, meski polisi berusaha mengendalikan mereka.
claims.quote: within two hours a mob of 'hunters' from all over London and beyond swarmed over gates and walls into the locked cemetery, despite police efforts to control them.

claims.statement: According to Wikipedia, Farrant was jailed for four years and eight months in July 1974 for damaging memorials and interfering with dead remains in Highgate Cemetery.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Wikipedia, Farrant dipenjara empat tahun delapan bulan pada Juli 1974 karena merusak monumen dan mengusik jenazah di Highgate Cemetery.
claims.quote: Farrant was jailed for four years and eight months in July 1974 for damaging memorials and interfering with dead remains in Highgate Cemetery

claims.statement: According to Wikipedia, the feud between Farrant and Manchester continued for decades, marked by insults and vindictiveness, until Farrant's death in April 2019.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Wikipedia, perseteruan Farrant dan Manchester berlanjut puluhan tahun, ditandai hinaan dan dendam, sampai Farrant meninggal pada April 2019.
claims.quote: Their feud continued for decades, marked by insults and vindictiveness, until Farrant's death in April 2019.

claims.statement: According to author Bill Ellis, the Hammer Horror film Dracula AD 1972, starring Christopher Lee and Peter Cushing, was inspired by the Highgate Vampire.
claims.statement_id: Menurut penulis Bill Ellis, film Hammer Horror Dracula AD 1972 yang dibintangi Christopher Lee dan Peter Cushing terinspirasi dari Highgate Vampire.
claims.quote: According to author Bill Ellis, the Hammer Horror film Dracula AD 1972, starring Christopher Lee and Peter Cushing, was inspired by the Highgate Vampire.

claims.statement: According to Far Out Magazine, the British Psychic and Occult Society began receiving reports of a tall black apparition stalking the tombs of London.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Far Out Magazine, British Psychic and Occult Society mulai menerima laporan tentang penampakan hitam tinggi yang menguntit makam-makam di London.
claims.quote: the British Psychic and Occult Society began receiving reports of a tall black apparition stalking the tombs of London

claims.statement: According to Far Out Magazine, the Hampstead and Highgate Express in February 1970 ran an article suggesting the local sightings were proof of a vampire and of occult activity in Highgate.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Far Out Magazine, surat kabar Hampstead and Highgate Express pada Februari 1970 menerbitkan artikel yang menyiratkan penampakan setempat adalah bukti adanya vampir dan aktivitas okultisme di Highgate.
claims.quote: in which they suggested the local sightings were proof of a vampire and evidence of occult activity in Highgate cemetery.

claims.statement: According to Far Out Magazine, Farrant remained unconvinced, blaming the sightings on mass hysteria generated by the press.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Far Out Magazine, Farrant tetap tidak yakin dan menyalahkan penampakan itu pada histeria massa yang ditimbulkan pers.
claims.quote: Farrant, on the other hand, remained unconvinced, blaming the sightings on mass hysteria generated by the press.

claims.statement: According to Far Out Magazine, in August 1970 two schoolgirls stumbled across the 100-year-old corpse of a woman who had been dragged from her coffin, decapitated, staked through the heart, and left in the middle of the pathway.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Far Out Magazine, pada Agustus 1970 dua siswi menemukan jenazah berusia 100 tahun milik seorang perempuan yang diseret dari petinya, dipenggal, ditusuk kayu di jantung, dan ditinggalkan di tengah jalan setapak.
claims.quote: In the August of 1970, two schoolgirls stumbled across the 100-year-old corpse of a woman who had been dragged from her coffin, decapitated, staked through the heart, and left in the middle of the pathway.
